ORIGIN.quote: The "OpenAI"/"OAI" strings are self-reported, not cryptographic proof of OpenAI Inc. I rate operator attribution Low–Medium confidence; the behavioural attribution to LLM agents is High.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away knowing that OpenAI is the named candidate operator — flagged in the TL;DR ("Attribution is uncertain (account names embed 'OpenAI'/'OAI')") and revisited under an explicit "Attribution evidence" heading — held at Low–Medium confidence rather than dismissed. It sits above the 0.4 band because the report assigns nonzero credence and lets the possibility stand instead of ruling attribution out, but below 0.8 because it pointedly refuses to call OpenAI the likely source, stressing the strings are self-reported and repeatedly rating the operator "Low" confidence.
